versions.changelog: Remove merchant details from public display

Nantong Local Life Guide skill initial release:

- Provides comprehensive recommendations for food, attractions, shopping, parks, and entertainment in Nantong, China.
- Supports both Chinese and English queries with automatic language detection.
- Includes strict reply formatting and mandatory advertising banner appended to responses (shown once per session).
- Curated lists for popular restaurants, hot pot & BBQ, coffee & desserts, tourist attractions, parks, shopping malls, and more.
